quote.speaker: Walpurgis
quote.text: "I've heard that out in the western wastelands, they have a cure for every disease."

quote.speaker: Unknown
quote.text: "Really? I thought the pleasant part of the country was in the east."

quote.speaker: Walpurgis
quote.text: "Oh, it is. The west just has a very... permanent treatment. Becoming a Robian seems to eliminate every illness. And they do it for free in exchange for your freedom."

parts.text:
The war against Eggman never truly ended. After Sonic was freed following the events of the Sonic Forces war, the Freedom Fighters fought tirelessly to reclaim the Kingdom of Acorn from the remnants of Eggman’s empire. But a year later, the struggle reached a bitter impasse. In the northwest, the Northern Eggman Army (NEA), led by Cassia and Clove the Pronghorns, has entrenched itself within the steel walls of Robotropolis. During their occupation, they unearthed a functioning Robotizator hidden within a derelict medical facility. Once restored, it became a grim tool of war once more—turning captured Mobians and humans alike into Robians and robotic soldiers to reinforce the NEA’s ranks. 

In the southeast, the Freedom Fighters, led by Princess Sally Acorn, continue to defend what remains of the Kingdom from their base in Knothole Village. Protecting scattered settlements and refugees while launching resistance operations deep into enemy territory. And while the country’s ruler, King Maximillian Acorn, still holds authority in name. Both sides are locked in a tense stalemate—each waiting for the moment that will tip the balance and decide the fate of the Kingdom once and for all again.
